test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Adhere
solution: The correct answer is **"Condemn."** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • **"Adhere'** means to stick to something or follow a rule or principle. (मज़बूती से चिपक जाना, जुड़ जाना, संसक्त होना) • **Example: ***Make sure that the paper **adheres**__ firmly to the wall.* • **"Condemn"** means to express strong disapproval or criticize something severely. (किसी की तीव्र निंदा करना; दोषी या अपराधी ठहराना) __ • **Example:** *A government spokesman **condemned**__ the bombing as a cowardly act of terrorism.* • **"Condemn"** is the opposite of** "adhere"** as it implies going against something instead of following it. • So, the correct answer is **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **Establish** means to set up or create something. (संस्‍था, व्‍यवस्‍था आदि स्‍थापित करना, निर्धारित करना) • **Approve **means to agree with or give permission to something. (किसी को पसंद करना या उससे संतुष्‍ट होना; स्‍वीकार्य समझना) • **Compel **means to force someone to do something. (कुछ करने के लिए किसी को बाध्य या विवश करना) 1c3:Tcfc, The correct answer is **"ameliorate".**
